steps.code:
# Get all playlists from the library (paginate)
access_token = login_response['access_token']
playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error:", page)
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total playlists: {len(playlists)}")
for p in playlists:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'])
